capabilities: Render interactive timers from markdown code blocks
Start and stop timers with one tap, pausing other non-independent timers in the note
Insert a timer summary report table in the note
Reset all timers in a note
Save a session log to a configurable folder or file path
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in timer, so tracking timed sessions inside notes requires leaving the app or manual logging.
summary: Timer plugin that renders tap-to-start/stop timers in notes, with one-running-timer exclusivity, summary reports, and session log saving.
